raw_text:
Here’s the integrated 12-week plan summary that combines training (with fasted LISS option and Phase 3 intensity push), nutrition (including IF option), weekly flex meal, and diabetes-specific safety. Use this as the client-facing roadmap and adjust loads/calories from biweekly check-ins.

Key outcomes and safeguards
- Goals: fat loss 0.5–0.75 lb/week, HbA1c toward <6.5–7.0, stronger and fitter.
- Training frequency: 4 primary sessions/week + 1 hypertrophy circuit + optional 2–4 fasted LISS mornings.
- NEAT: 7,500–10,000 steps/day by Week 4; 9,000–12,000 by Week 12.
- Diabetes safety: pre-ex SMBG when feasible; carry 10–15 g fast carbs; avoid fasted intervals or heavy lifts; train fed when intensity is high. If <90 mg/dL, take 10–15 g carbs; 90–250 proceed; >250 favor LISS; >300 postpone.
- Check-ins: weekly weight/waist/SMBG trends; adjust food by ±100–150 kcal and carbs ±25 g biweekly.

Training overview by phase
- Weekly template (typical)
  - Day 1: Strength A (lower emphasis)
  - Day 2: LISS or Intervals + Core
  - Day 3: Strength B (upper + hinge)
  - Day 4: Rest or light mobility/yoga
  - Day 5: MetCon + Core
  - Day 6: Hypertrophy Circuit
  - Day 7: Rest
  - Optional AM fasted LISS 2–4 mornings/week (20–40 min Zone 2) with guardrails; avoid on heavy lower days.

Phase 1: Weeks 1–4 (Foundation and insulin sensitivity)
- Priorities: technique, consistency, SMBG learning, steps habit.
- Strength A/B core movements:
  - Goblet squat, DB/BB bench, lat pulldown, DB RDL, hip thrust, leg press, seated row, DB OHP, split squat; later introduce light BB back squat and trap bar deadlift.
  - Sets/reps: 3–4 sets, 8–12 reps, RPE 6–7; rest 60–120 s.
- Conditioning:
  - LISS 30–38 min Zone 2; add intervals by Week 3 (8x45s hard/1:15 easy).
- MetCon + Core: Rounds of KB swings, step-ups, ropes, incline push-ups, air bike; RPE ≤7.5.
- Hypertrophy Circuit: machine chest/row/leg curl/lateral raise/calf/back extension in circuits.
- Optional fasted AM LISS:
  - W1–2: 2x/week 20–25 min
  - W3–4: 3x/week 25–30 min
  - Only if SMBG stable; stop if symptomatic.
- Progression: add 2–5% load when all reps achieved; add a set to main lifts by Week 2–3.

Phase 2: Weeks 5–8 (Progressive overload and density)
- Strength emphasis:
  - Back squat 4x6 (RPE ~7), bench 4x6–8, chest-supported or seated row 3–4x8–10, RDL 3–4x6–8, trap bar deadlift 4x5, single-leg press/lunge 2–3x10–12, landmine press 3x8–10, lat pulldown 3x8–10.
  - Superset pairings from Week 7 to increase density.
- Conditioning:
  - Intervals progress to 10x40s hard/80s easy; 1–2 LISS sessions 38–40 min.
- MetCon EMOM/AMRAP sessions at RPE ~7.5–8.
- Hypertrophy Circuit: 3–4 giant-set rounds, 60–90 s rest between rounds.
- Week 8 micro-deload: reduce loads to 85–90% and drop one set; LISS only.
- Optional fasted LISS:
  - W5–8: 3x/week 30–35 min, skip morning walk on heavy leg or interval days if fatigue/SMBG off.

Phase 3: Weeks 9–12 (Intensification with top sets, clusters, and sharper intervals)
- Global rules: main lift top set at RPE 8–8.5 then back-offs; accessory supersets 60–75 s rest; crisp intervals; no fasted HIIT.
- Week 9
  - Strength A: Back squat top 1x4@RPE 8–8.5 + 3x4@90%; hip thrust 4x6; walking lunge 3x10/leg; farmer carry; 6-min incline finisher.
  - Strength B: Trap bar DL top 1x3@RPE 8 + 3x3@90%; bench top 1x5@RPE 8 + 3x5@92%; row 4x8; Bulgarians 3x8/leg; bike 6x30s/60s.
  - Intervals: 8x45s hard/75s easy (fed).
  - Hypertrophy Density: 4 giant-set rounds (leg press, incline DB press, pulldown, DB RDL) + pump finisher.
- Week 10
  - Add 2–3% load or 1 rep where RPE allows.
  - Strength A: top 1x3 squat + 3x3@90–92%; hip thrust 5x5; reverse lunge 3x8/leg; sled pushes.
  - Strength B: trap bar DL 4x3@RPE 8 across; bench top 1x4 + 3x4@92%; heavy pulldown 4x6–8; landmine press 3x8/side; assault bike efforts.
  - EMOM 18 conditioning: bike cals, heavy KB swings, burpees.
- Week 11 (peak with clusters)
  - Strength A: squat clusters 4x(2+2) @ ~85–88%, 20–25 s intra-rest; RDL 4x5 (3-sec ecc); FF-elevated split squat 3x8/leg; rower sprints 8x20s/70s.
  - Strength B: trap bar DL clusters 4x(1+1+1) @ ~88–90%; bench top 1x3 + 3x3@92%; heavy rows; 5-min KB complex finisher.
  - Threshold conditioning: 3x6 min hard with 3 min easy between.
- Week 12 (consolidate)
  - Reduce volume ~20–25%; keep intensity moderate-high (RPE ≤8); speed focus.
  - Strength A: squat 4x3@~80–82%; hip thrust 3x5; light lunge; 8–10 min incline walk.
  - Strength B: trap bar DL 4x2@~80–85%; bench 3x4@~80–82%; row 3x8; 6x30s/60s bike RPE 7.5.
  - Conditioning choice: 6x45s hard/75s easy or EMOM 15 (keep RPE ≤7.5).
  - Hypertrophy: 3 quality rounds; skip finisher.
- Optional fasted LISS in Phase 3:
  - W9–12: 3–4 mornings/week, 30–40 min Zone 2, but not before heavy lower sessions; keep SMBG guardrails.

Warm-up, technique, and recovery
- Warm-up 10–12 min: 5 min easy cardio; dynamic hips/ankles/T-spine; activation (glute bridge, band row, dead bug).
- Rest: compounds 90–150 s; accessories 60–90 s (shorter in Phase 3).
- Tempo: control eccentrics (2–3 s) on squats, RDLs, presses.
- Mobility: 10 min on rest days; focus calves/ankles/hips, thoracic rotation.
- Sleep: 7–9 hours; consistent schedule.
- Stress: 5–10 min breathwork; light walks after meals.

Conditioning and SMBG rules
- Intervals and MetCon always fed (60–120 min post balanced meal).
- Pre-session SMBG when possible:
  - <90 mg/dL: 10–15 g rapid carbs
  - 90–250 mg/dL: proceed
  - >250 mg/dL: favor LISS; >300 postpone
- Post-session: check 1–2 hours until patterns are known.
- Foot care and hydration: supportive footwear; 2–3 L/day fluids; electrolytes if hot.

Nutrition framework
- Calories: ~300–400 kcal/day deficit. Start around 12–13 kcal/lb goal body weight on training days; 11–12 kcal/lb on rest days. Adjust biweekly to keep 0.5–0.75 lb/week loss.
- Protein: 1.6–2.2 g/kg (1.0–1.1 g/lb goal BW), split over 3–4 feedings.
- Carbs: 35–45% calories to start; low–moderate GI, fiber-rich; time around training and earlier in day.
- Fats: 25–30% calories; emphasize mono/polyunsaturated.
- Fiber: 28–35 g/day.
- Sodium/potassium/magnesium adequate unless contraindicated.

Meal timing and options
- Pre-workout (strength/intervals; 60–120 min prior): 25–35 g protein + 30–45 g low–moderate GI carbs. Examples: chicken + quinoa + veg; yogurt + oats; tofu + rice + veg.
- Post-workout (within 2 hrs): 25–35 g protein + 25–45 g carbs (e.g., salmon + sweet potato + salad; shake + fruit + nuts).
- Fasted LISS mornings: water/coffee only if SMBG 90–250; if <90, take 10–15 g quick carbs; eat balanced breakfast within 60 min after.
- Quick post-workout snacks (examples):
  - Greek yogurt + berries + chia; protein shake + small apple; cottage cheese + pineapple; turkey roll-ups + small wrap; edamame + rice crackers; RTD protein + almonds.

Intermittent fasting (optional)
- Use only if it makes adherence easier and training stays fueled.
- Gentle TRE 12:12 to 14:10 most days; 16:8 up to 2–3 days/week if tolerated.
- Prefer 9–7 or 10–6 type windows; open window earlier on training days.
- Keep calories/protein unchanged; monitor SMBG closely for 1–2 weeks after changes.

Weekly flex meal integration
- 1 planned flex meal/week, ideally post-training and earlier in the day.
- Keep daily calories at maintenance to +10–15% (e.g., if 1,700 kcal target, aim 1,900–2,000 on that day).
- Protein ≥25–35 g at the meal; veg starter + vinegar; water/diet drink; 12–20 min post-meal walk.
- Template ideas: salad + 2 slices thin-crust pizza; burger + half fries + salad; fajitas + 2 corn tortillas; sushi 8–10 pieces + edamame.
- If post-meal SMBG >180 mg/dL repeatedly, scale portions or move flex meal immediately post-workout.

Week-by-week focus
- Weeks 1–2: establish logging, protein target, step habit, SMBG routine; trial 2 fasted LISS mornings.
- Weeks 3–4: refine carb quality/timing; add intervals; expand fasted LISS to 3 mornings if stable.
- Weeks 5–6: progressive overload; fiber to 28–35 g/day; replace refined snacks.
- Week 7: density supersets; sustain NEAT; ensure sleep is 7–9 h.
- Week 8: micro-deload; technique, mobility, LISS only for conditioning.
- Week 9: intensity ramp with top sets; crisp intervals.
- Week 10: small load bumps; sled/bike finishers.
- Week 11: cluster sets peak; threshold conditioning; protect recovery.
- Week 12: consolidate; test submax performance markers; plan next cycle.

Supplement options (confirm with provider)
- Creatine monohydrate 3–5 g/day
- Whey/casein or soy to hit protein targets
- Omega-3 EPA/DHA 1–2 g/day if intake low
- Magnesium glycinate 200–300 mg/day
- Vitamin D per labs

Decision rules and adjustments
- If weight loss stalls 2+ weeks: add 1,500 steps/day or reduce 100–150 kcal/day (mainly carbs/fats), keep protein.
- If SMBG high after morning fasted LISS: shift those walks to post-breakfast or after meals.
- If strength performance drops two sessions in a row: add 20–30 g carbs pre-workout, ensure 7–9 h sleep, consider a light day.

This integrated plan aligns training intensity and progression with diabetes-aware nutrition, optional IF, fasted LISS guardrails, and a weekly flex meal—giving you a precise yet flexible roadmap for the 12 weeks.
